Name: TBC-T1 Rejecting cookies hides the consent banner and the choice survives reload and navigation
Objective: A visitor who rejects optional cookies is not asked again on the next page load or page.
Precondition: Fresh browser context (no tbcbank.ge cookies or local storage). Test data: Locale en, banner title Cookie Consent.
Test Script Plain Text: 1) Open https://tbcbank.ge/en => Home page loads, the cookie consent banner is shown 2) Check the banner => Title is "Cookie Consent", a description is present, three actions are offered (Accept All, Customize, Reject All) 3) Click Reject All => Banner disappears and cookie tbc-ge-cookie-consent-v1 stores result = reject-all (it did not exist before the choice) 4) Reload the page => Banner stays hidden 5) Open /en/loans/consumer-loan => Page opens and the banner is still hidden

Name: TBC-T2 Switch language and complete the consumer loan journey in the selected locale
Objective: The same journey works in Georgian and English after the visitor switches the language.
Precondition: Fresh browser context, cookie banner dismissed. Test data: See docs/zephyr/ZEPHYR_TEST_CASES.md
Test Script Plain Text: 1) Open the home page in the *other* locale => Home page loads 2) Click the language switcher => Site reloads content for the target locale, URL becomes /{locale}, <html lang> is the target locale 3) Check the header => Switcher offers the opposite language, logo links to /{locale} 4) Hover Personal and choose the consumer loan link => Link label is localized, /{locale}/loans/consumer-loan opens 5) Check the page => Localized breadcrumbs, every breadcrumb link stays under /{locale}, localized heading, 3 benefits, localized CTA pointing to /{locale}/loans/consumer-loan/digital 6) Click the CTA => Terms page opens in the same locale with the four-level localized breadcrumb, localized heading and the terms tabs

Name: TBC-T3 Currency calculator converts database-driven amounts with the quoted rate
Objective: The calculator converts any stored amount using the rate it displays.
Precondition: Local H2 database seeded from testdata/schema.sql and testdata/data.sql; only rows with active = TRUE are used. Test data: See docs/zephyr/ZEPHYR_TEST_CASES.md
Test Script Plain Text: 1) US dollar small amount => USD | GEL | 100.00 | $ | yes 2) Euro medium amount => EUR | GEL | 250.00 | EUR sign | yes 3) Pound sterling large amount => GBP | GEL | 1500.00 | GBP sign | yes 4) Swiss franc fractional amount => CHF | GEL | 75.50 | CHF | yes 5) Turkish lira low rate currency => TRY | GEL | 1000.00 | TRY sign | yes 6) Japanese yen weighted rate => JPY | GEL | 5000.00 | JPY sign | no 7) Open /en/valutis-kursi => Calculator shows USD -> GEL with a "1 USD = x GEL" description 8) Choose the stored sell currency => Selected currency and amount symbol match the record, description quotes "1 {sell} = x {buy}" 9) Type the stored amount => Sell field shows the amount 10) Read the quoted rate => Buy field equals amount x rate rounded to 2 decimals 11) Check the URL => URL ends with /{sell}-to-{buy}?amount={amount}

Name: TBC-T4 Selecting a currency requests its rate from the exchange API and renders it
Objective: The calculator fetches the rate for the chosen currency and shows exactly that value.
Precondition: Currency page open with the default USD -> GEL pair. Test data: Sell currency EUR, buy currency GEL, amount 100.
Test Script Plain Text: 1) Choose EUR in the sell dropdown while listening to network traffic => One request to /api/v1/exchangeRates/getExchangeRate is captured 2) Inspect the request => Method GET, query Iso1=EUR, Iso2=GEL 3) Inspect the response => Status 200, body iso1=EUR, iso2=GEL, buyRate > 0, sellRate >= buyRate 4) Check the UI => Description is "1 EUR = {buyRate} GEL", buy field is 100 x buyRate, URL ends with /EUR-to-GEL?amount=100

Name: TBC-T5 Swapping currencies reverses the conversion direction and recalculates the amount
Objective: Swapping currencies reverses the conversion direction and recalculates the amount
Precondition: Currency page open with USD -> GEL.
Test Script Plain Text: 1) Click the swap button => A new rate for GEL -> USD is requested 2) Check the calculator => Sell is GEL (GEL sign), buy is USD ($), description quotes "1 GEL = x USD" 3) Check the result => Buy field equals 100 x quoted rate, URL ends with /GEL-to-USD?amount=100

Name: TBC-T6 Reach Consumer Loan through the mega menu and return to Loans through the breadcrumbs
Objective: Reach Consumer Loan through the mega menu and return to Loans through the breadcrumbs
Test Script Plain Text: 1) Hover Personal in the header => Mega menu opens with the Personal sub menu 2) Click Consumer => /en/loans/consumer-loan opens with breadcrumbs Home > Loans > Consumer loan and heading "Consumer Loan" 3) Click the Loans breadcrumb => /en/loans opens with breadcrumbs Home > Loans 4) Click the Home breadcrumb => /en opens

Name: TBC-T7 Consumer Loan page renders the heading, benefits, CTA and breadcrumbs served by the content API
Objective: The UI shows exactly what the CMS delivery API returns (the API is the source of truth). Runs for en-US and ka-GE.
Test Script Plain Text: 1) GET /api/v1/sites/{siteId} and find the page with slug /loans/consumer-loan => Page id is returned 2) GET /api/v1/sites/pages/{id}?locale={code} and map it to ContentPage => First ctaSection has a heading, benefits list and a primary button 3) Open /{locale}/loans/consumer-loan => Page loads 4) Compare => Browser title = seo.title; breadcrumbs = breadcrumbs.items[].label; heading = richTextTitle heading-1; description = bodyText; benefits = list[].label in order; CTA text = buttons[0].label, href = /{locale} + buttons[0].link.url

Name: TBC-T11 Commercial rate list and direct rate endpoint agree on the EUR to GEL rate
Objective: Commercial rate list and direct rate endpoint agree on the EUR to GEL rate
Test Script Plain Text: 1) GET /api/v1/exchangeRates/commercialList?locale=en-US and ka-GE => 200, rates[] has at least 5 currencies including USD and EUR 2) Check every rate => Buy > 0, sell >= buy, official rate between buy and sell, weight > 0 3) GET /api/v1/exchangeRates/getExchangeRate?Iso1=EUR&Iso2=GEL => Buy rate, sell rate and weight equal the EUR row of the list 4) Compare locales => Rates are identical, currency names are translated
